integrity: Exact mathematical argument reconstructed using Haar correlations and Peter–Weyl. Finite-group code is a diagnostic rather than an infinite proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only compact connected metrizable groups; no theorem for noncompact or disconnected groups. The Fourier filter is existential; no uniform spectral bound. Classical Jaworski–Chen continuous embedding and Peter–Weyl theorem used as external prerequisites. Bibliographic overlap risk remains.
title: The Lipschitz Bebutov–Kakutani criterion for compact connected groups
